{{Note
|user= .kju
|timestamp= 20100802101900
|text= Only works in SP and on the MP Host/DS. It returns the mission pboprefix if available, otherwise the pboname. For clients it returns '__cur_mp'.
}}

{{Note
|user= Kenoxite
|timestamp= 20140925080500
|text= Prior to {{GVI|ofp|1.96}} it returns the mission filename. Since {{GVI|ofp|1.99}}, it returns the briefing name instead when in multiplayer. The string displayed is that set in the Intel section of the mission editor.
|game= ofp
|version= 1.99
}}
